g.text: STEAM EJECTOR VACUUM OTS VER 1 · CHULALONGKORN CHEMICAL ENGINEERING
VACUUM COLUMN T-101 WITH TWO-STAGE STEAM-EJECTOR SYSTEM
1. Issued for teaching. All flags are the simulator model's design state (warm start 7200 s, noise off).
2. Flows kg/h; temperatures °C; pressures kPa a. Unflagged streams carry no model value.
3. J-203 hogger and its streams run at start-up only (zero at design).
4. Utilities: cw cooling water, chw chilled water, lps 3.5 bar a steam. S-210 drains through trap ST-210 (not shown).
